jobDescription:
Who We Are

Founded by Mohan Lakhamraju, Arjun Nair, and Hari Nair, Great Learning began its journey in
2013, teaching Data Science to a single batch of 28 passionate learners. Today, we have grown
into a global community with over 6,800 mentors and expert faculty members from both
industry and academia, reaching students in more than 170 countries.
Over the past 10+ years, we have delivered more than 301 million hours of learning to over 10
million learners, leading to thousands of successful career transitions. Many of our programs
have been consistently ranked No.1 in the country, a testament to the quality of education we
provide despite fierce competition.
Our esteemed university partners include Stanford University, MIT, Northwestern University, the
University of Texas at Austin, Great Lakes Institute of Management, SRM University, National
University of Singapore and other universities of similar repute are going to be partners in the
Great Learning journey soon.
Our Mission: To enable career success in the digital economy through transformational learning
experiences.

Learn more about us and our journey so far: https://www.mygreatlearning.com/about-us
Visit our career page: https://www.mygreatlearning.com/careers

“Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn”

– Benjamin Franklin

Why Join Us
Over the past few years, Ed Tech has experienced steady growth, with a heightened emphasis on
upskilling, driving significant, much-needed changes in the professional landscape. To put this
into perspective:
Great Learning has firmly established itself as a global leader in the Ed Tech space for
professional education and upskilling, recognized as the #1 Ed Tech Startup in 2020.
India’s Ed Tech market is projected to grow from $3.5 billion in 2022 to $10.4 billion by 2025.
The number of paid users for skill development courses is expected to increase from 2.31 million
in 2020 to over 8.5 million by 2025.
The demand for new-age skills like Data Science, AI, and ML is skyrocketing, with universities
worldwide collaborating with Ed Tech companies to deliver cutting-edge programs.
Great Learning has deeply rooted itself in the Higher Education and Skill Development category
and continues to grow rapidly with a technology-first approach, meeting the evolving needs of
learners globally.

The Role

● Drive inquiries & admissions for the online/blended learning programs for Data
Science(AI&ML) offered for the International Market.
● Look after the entire sales life cycle: starting from engaging with the large volume of
well qualified leads till the final conversion i.e. enrolment in the program.
● Counsel experienced professionals via call or email on which course will be useful to
their career progression and suggest the best options.
● Update and maintain MIS reports.

Requirements
● Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification (in any discipline). Post-graduation Degree
shall be an add-on.
● More than 2 years of work experience, primarily in Counseling or Sales (in any sector)
● Sales exposure with the UK Market will be advantageous.
● Strong sales acumen and Excellent communication skills (verbal and spoken)
● Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
● Ability to do presentations on Video Calls with the professionals.
● Team player.
● A strong passion for personal career growth and contributing to the success of emerging
brands
Interview Process

● Exploratory Discussion – An initial conversation to assess the candidate's basic fitment
based on communication skills, spontaneity, intent, relevance of past experience, and
ability to handle the roles and responsibilities.
● Cultural fitment round – A deeper assessment of the candidate's fit for the role,
including their comprehension and understanding of the responsibilities, sales acumen,
and technical knowledge of the product.
● Managerial & Team fitment round with Senior Management - A final evaluation to
discuss the candidate's potential impact, past achievements, growth trajectory, and
overall fit within the team and organization.

title: Sales Trainer
jobDescription:
The Role

  • Nurture, train, and motivate salesforce for ensuring organizational targets.
  • Train new Learning Consultants (Inside Sales Professionals) by conducting orientation to the sales process; developing individual coaching plans; providing resources and assistance; scheduling orientation with senior representatives.
  • Evaluate sales team performance to ensure incorporation of taught techniques.
  • Determine training needs by shadowing sales representatives; listening to calls; conferring with sales managers.
  • Develop individual results by maintaining policy and procedure resources; providing coaching; conducting training sessions; developing outcome improvement resources.
  • Report on training program effectiveness.
  • Oversee training material and suggest improvements.
  • Improves training effectiveness by developing new approaches and techniques; making support readily available; integrating support with routine job functions. requirements

title: Senior Product Manager
jobDescription:
The Role

As a Senior Product Manager at Great Learning, you will own end-to-end outcomes for a critical product area—either:


  • Growth & Monetization: driving lead generation, funnel conversion, and revenue growth in close partnership with Sales and Marketing, or

  • Learner experience: shaping the core learning journey, engagement, and outcomes for our learners.


You will


  • Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for your product area, aligned with company goals.

  • Own key product metrics and use data, research, and stakeholder inputs to identify high-impact problems and opportunities.

  • Continuously identify and drive AI-powered solutions that make Great Learning an AI-native organization.

  • Translate user and business needs into clear product requirements and partner with design and engineering to deliver solutions.

  • Ensure the front-end experience, back-end capabilities, and system logic come together to solve user problems effectively.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Academics to launch and scale product features successfully.

  • Work with the analytics team to design experiments, measure impact, and iterate rapidly on product changes.

  • Champion the learner and shape how online education is delivered today and in the future at Great Learning.


Requirements


  • 3–6 years of relevant product management experience with demonstrated end-to-end ownership of significant product areas.

  • MBA or technical degree (or equivalent experience) with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Demonstrated AI fluency, ideally with experience in building or integrating AI-powered products or workflows.

  • Proven ability to break down ambiguous problems, prioritize ruthlessly, and make data-informed decisions.

  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working with design, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.

  • Comfort owning both the user experience and the underlying product logic across front-end and back-end components.

  • Passion for Ed Tech and for building products that improve learner outcomes and drive business growth.

title: Senior Program Advisor - Northwest Sales
jobDescription:
The ROLE:

You will be the first point of contact for senior professionals (C-Suite, senior execs) exploring executive education programs. As a Learning Consultant, you’ll deeply understand their business context, leadership career goals, and learning needs, and advise them on the right leadership development programs.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:
● Engage with high-potential professionals via phone, email, SMS, and video calls/meets to build rapport and understand their leadership career goals.
● Evaluate their background, experience, and aspirations to align the relevant executive education program.
● Manage and drive the entire sales funnel: lead qualification → nurturing → application submission → closing → enrollment (payment).
● Maintain detailed interaction records in CRM; update pipeline and performance metrics.
● Collaborate with managers and marketing to refine messaging, improve lead quality, and optimize conversion strategies.
● Work with Academic / Ops teams to stay updated on program offerings, differentiate value propositions, and tailor conversations.
● Achieve and exceed a cohort’s enrollment and revenue targets.
● Build and sustain long-term relationships with enrolled executives; encourage referrals and repeat business.
● Provide ongoing feedback to internal teams to improve the learner journey, from inquiry to program completion.
● Ability to do basic market research - look at some of the best practices and do competitor analysis. Provide feedback or suggestions on any opportunities.
● Be flexible in working hours to accommodate US-time zone interactions.

QUALIFICATIONS:
● 3+ years of sales / consultative sales experience, preferably in education, Ed Tech, or executive education. Prior US-market experience preferred.
● Proven track record in a high-touch sales environment, working with senior professionals.
● Excellent communicator - able to engage, influence, and build trust with C-level executives.
● Strong organizational and CRM skills.
● Analytical mindset: manage data, track metrics, generate insights.
● Empathy, active listening, and the ability to act as a trusted advisor.
● Willingness to work US-aligned hours and in a fast-paced, global environment.

title: Senior CopyWriter
jobDescription:
Copywriter – Job Description

We are looking for a detail-oriented and research-driven Copywriter with strong long-form writing capabilities to create compelling content for domestic and global audiences. The ideal candidate should have experience developing marketing and educational content assets, with a keen eye for clarity, accuracy, storytelling, and brand consistency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop comprehensive long-form content assets such as program brochures, career guides, curriculum guides, project reports, one-pagers, mailers, and other marketing collateral to support learner engagement and program promotion.

  • Edit and proofread marketing materials to ensure grammatical accuracy, consistency, clarity, and alignment with brand tone and messaging.

  • Manage and maintain a structured content calendar to ensure timely creation, review, and updates of all content assets.

  • Review and refine content created by junior writers, providing constructive feedback and mentoring to improve overall content quality.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including designers, marketing teams, and internal stakeholders to create and update content based on evolving business requirements.

  • Conduct in-depth secondary research on emerging technologies, industry trends, career pathways, and the evolving edtech landscape to create insightful and informative content.

  • Work on data-driven research reports by collecting, filtering, analyzing, and presenting information in a clear and structured format.

  • Write high-performing ad copy, blogs, emailers, and digital marketing content to support lead generation and program marketing initiatives.

  • Analyze content performance and marketing data to improve the effectiveness of communication assets across channels.


    What We’re Looking For

    • Master’s degree in English or Journalism,

    • 3–4 years of experience in copywriting, content marketing, or editorial roles, preferably in the edtech or education industry.

    • Strong research and analytical skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts into engaging, audience-friendly narratives.

    • Exceptional editing, proofreading, and grammar skills with strong attention to detail.

    • Proven experience in creating long-form marketing and informational content.

    • Strong understanding of marketing communication and brand storytelling for a US/global audience.

    • Ability to maintain a consistent brand voice across multiple formats and channels.

title: Senior Learning Consultant - Domestic Sales
jobDescription:
Role Overview

As a Learning Consultant/Senior Learning Consultant, you will be responsible for driving enrollments for our high-end, premium professional certification and degree programs (including advanced programs in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Business Analytics in partnership with top global universities like IIT Bombay and Johns Hopkins University). You will act as a trusted advisor to working professionals and students, helping them choose the right career path and educational programs to accelerate their careers.

.Key Responsibilities

  • Consultative Sales: Engage with prospective learners to understand their career goals and provide personalized program recommendations that bridge the gap between their current skills and aspirations.
  • End-to-End Funnel Management: Own the entire sales journey, including lead qualification, career counseling, objection handling, and driving enrollments.
  • Strategic Revenue Growth: Consistently meet and exceed monthly enrollment and revenue targets while delivering a superior customer experience.
  • Data-Driven Reporting: Maintain meticulous records of customer interactions and sales activities in our CRM/MIS systems.
  • Collaboration: Partner with internal teams to ensure a seamless onboarding experience for new learners.
  • Ideal Candidate Profile

EDUCATION:

  • Candidates with an Engineering background (B.Tech/B.E) or Postgraduates (MBA/PGDM) are preferred. While a technical foundation is an advantage, what truly stands out is strong learning agility, quick grasping ability, and excellent information retention.
  • Experience: Professionals with 1-4 years of proven sales experience who have consistently demonstrated strong communication, relationship-building, and conversion capabilities.
  • Freshers: Highly motivated, ambitious freshers with exceptional communication skills and a "can-do" attitude are welcome to apply.
  • Industry Background: Candidates with experience in high-touch, consultative sales environments, particularly Ed Tech/Education, Hospitality, BFSI, or Real Estate, are preferred.

Key Competencies

  • Communication & Influence: Exceptional ability to build trust, listen actively, and influence decision-making through consultative conversations.
  • Learning Agility & Tech Awareness: Strong ability to quickly grasp, retain, and explain technical trends (e.g., AI/ML, Data Science). We value learning agility and retention over a simple resume scan of past technical roles.
  • Learning Agility & Retention: Ability to quickly grasp new technical concepts, retain information, and apply it in consultative conversations, even without a deep technical background.
  • Resilience & Drive: A performance-oriented mindset; comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and resilient in handling targets and objections.
  • Ownership: High level of accountability and a customer-first approach.
Why Join Us?

  • Career Impact: Directly contribute to the professional growth of learners.
  • Performance Culture: Work in an environment that values high performers and provides clear pathways for growth.
  • High-Growth Domain: Be at the forefront of the AI and Ed Tech revolution.
  • Comprehensive Health Insurance – Medical coverage of up to ₹4 Lakhs.
  • Annual Learning Allowance – ₹10,000 yearly to support continuous learning and upskilling.
  • Mental Wellness Support – 24x7 counseling access for employees and up to 2 family members through Your Dost.
  • Healthy Workplace Perks – Nutritious lunch and fresh fruits provided at work.
